package_version_source: docs/literature/raw/description_fixest.txt; repository declaration, not proof of latest published release
capabilities: Multiway fixed effects, IV, GLM and inference
limitation: GPL review; specify the estimand before the regression formula
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Formula, multiple effects, optional instruments, weights and covariance specification.
scientific_qualification.output: Linear/GLM or IV coefficients with selected inference.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Scientific regression/IV restrictions and weighting target are established outside formula parsing.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Retain formula expansion, absorbed effects, observations dropped and inference defaults. Benchmark claims cannot be transferred across hardware or a different estimand.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Check explicit-dummy equivalence, treatment collinearity, singleton handling and same-target agreement with a Python reference.

evidence.finding: Multiway FE/IV/GLM features, inference and performance comparison caveats.
